items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I remember the night, uh, he was, when he was awake with Sam Morgan's band... I was staying right up there when the lady cut him when I saw that well I just being a kid you know I got excited I broke and run man

ctx.x: Well, Alfred Williams, uh, the same for him, tell you, uh, Faiso, Rudolph, Guy Rudolph. He played, he's still living right now. The big, bright guy?
